description: List the publisher sources (registered websites/sites) for the Tradedoubler account. Use this to discover available source/site IDs — the `id` of each source is the site ID used as the `a=` parameter in tracking links, and can be used as a filter in programme and transaction endpoints. Returns an array of sources with id, name, url, type, and status; pair with list_programmes to scope results to a specific site.
name: affiliate_tradedoubler_list_publisher_sources
